summary.text: Pete Morency is a Republican state representative from Coos District 5 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, where he has served since December 2024, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Peter Morency assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 4, 2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November 3 ballot for Coos 5, a two-seat district.
